answer_1.quote: In this paper, we present BAE (BERT-based Adversarial Examples), a novel technique using the BERT masked language model (MLM) for word replacements to better fit the overall context of the English language.

answer_2.quote: achieving significant drops of 40-80% in test accuracies, with higher average semantic similarities as shown in parentheses.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation of our BAE attacks on the BERT classifier. ... We calculate the sentiment accuracy by asking 3 annotators to predict the sentiment for each sentence ... To evaluate the naturalness of the adversarial examples, ... we then ask them to score each sentence (on a Likert scale of 1-5) ... on its grammar and likelihood of being from the original data.
answer_4.guideline: Score each sentence on a Likert scale of 1-5 based on grammar and likelihood of being from the original data.
